text:
Alex: Heads-up — dashboard p95 for /v1/generate dropped ~20ms in the last rollout but raw request logs show no change. Is the UI lying or are we folding something?
Priya: Hmm, could be an aggregation artifact. Are we rolling up percentiles across model variants now?
Mateo: We are doing a global rollup key: service->endpoint->model_family. That could mask tails if we merge sketches incorrectly.
Jing: Quick check: per-instance p95 from the instance metrics matches logs. The global p95 is notably lower. That smells like an incorrect merge/weighting.
Sara: Possible culprits: t-digest merge strategy + sampling + routing policy that injects cache hits as separate events. Any recent changes to sampling?
Alex: We explicitly disabled caching for that route in the rollout.
Priya: Pasting the current telemetry rollup config we used for the console:
```
rollup:
  group_by: [region, model_variant, endpoint]
  aggregator: tdigest
  tdigest_precision: 100
  sample_rate: 0.02
  merge_strategy: avg_quantiles  # yes, this is dumb
```
Mateo: avg_quantiles is exactly the issue — you can't average quantile values across sketches. You need to merge the sketches or recompute from raw counts.
Jing: Confirmed. If you average quantiles from different distributions you can understate the tail. That's why global p95 drifted down.
Sara: So options: (1) change merge_strategy to tdigest_merge (proper merge), (2) switch to hdr-histogram for rollups, or (3) compute percentiles at query time from stored per-shard summaries.
Alex: Tradeoffs: tdigest_merge is cheap storage-wise and fixes correctness if implemented right. hdr-histogram merges cleanly but storage grows. Query-time recompute is most accurate but expensive.
Priya: Also UX angle: console defaulting to global rollup is causing confusion. We should surface that aggregation is "across model variants" and show a per-instance toggle.
Mateo: I'll open two quick PRs: one to flip merge_strategy to tdigest_merge in prod pipeline and one to add a per-instance toggle + tooltip in the console.
Jing: For safety, we should patch a backfill job to recompute rollups for the last 24h once tdigest_merge is live so charts don't flip unexpectedly.
Sara: Filing an infra task for storage/cost estimate if we consider hdr-histogram.
Alex: Good. For the rollout UX, can we add a small red flag icon when the aggregation changed in the last 7 days? That will help SREs notice sudden shifts.
Priya: Agree. Also add a note in the changelog and alert owners if rollup configuration flips.
Mateo: PRs incoming in ~30m. I'll also add a unit test that simulates merging two skewed tdigest sketches to assert p95 monotonicity.
deploy-bot: Incident created: IN-2026-48 telemetry-aggregation-checklist. Assigned: @Mateo, @Priya.
Alex: Thanks all — after PRs land let's monitor the endpoint for a few hours and communicate the change on #product-dashboard so product folks aren't surprised. :thumbsup:
